conditions.meaning: Water is more acidic than the acceptable pH range.
pH is within the acceptable BIS reference range.
Water is more alkaline than the acceptable pH range.
TDS is within the acceptable BIS reference limit.
TDS is above the acceptable limit but within the permissible limit when no alternate source is available.
TDS exceeds the BIS permissible limit.
Turbidity is within the acceptable BIS reference limit.
Turbidity is above the acceptable limit but within the permissible limit when no alternate source is available.
Turbidity exceeds the BIS permissible limit.
Temperature is monitored and used as an input to the deep learning model. No project-specific drinking-water safety threshold is assigned.

overall_interpretation.rule: The overall monitored water-quality status should consider all available parameter results and the CNN-LSTM model prediction.
overall_interpretation.safe_condition: All monitored parameters are within their acceptable reference ranges and the CNN-LSTM model predicts Safe.
overall_interpretation.unsafe_condition: One or more monitored parameters exceed the applicable permissible limit or the CNN-LSTM model predicts Unsafe.
overall_interpretation.warning_condition: A parameter is above its acceptable limit but remains within its permissible limit, requiring attention.
overall_interpretation.important_note: The system evaluates only the parameters monitored by this project and should not claim complete drinking-water safety based only on pH, TDS, turbidity, and temperature.

rules.unsafe: Return Unsafe if any monitored parameter status is listed in unsafe_parameter_statuses or the model prediction is listed in unsafe_model_predictions.
rules.insufficient_data: If the model prediction is unavailable and no unsafe parameter condition has already been detected, return Insufficient data.
rules.warning: If any monitored parameter status is listed in warning_parameter_statuses, return Warning.
rules.safe: Return Safe only when no unsafe or warning parameter status exists and a valid Safe model prediction is available.
